findings.quote: Do not touch `supabase/` (no migrations, `9999_init.sql` may be frozen), `apps/web/vercel.json`, `proxy.ts`, or `next.config.ts` (3.4 changes headers).
findings.problem: 2.1a's CSP (G5, mirroring DESIGN §9) emits `media-src 'self' blob: https://<supabase host>` on every non-share page. 3.3a's `LinkPreview` and `SermonPlayer` render `<audio>/<video src={streamUrl}>` for Dropbox (`dl.dropboxusercontent.com`) and 'other https' links (PLAN §6 / DESIGN §7 `native_stream`), which the browser will block under that CSP. The prompt forbids the only fix, and 3.4 widens `media-src` for `/s/:path*` only, so the admin pages ship with Dropbox/https playback permanently broken. This is listed in open_issues but not resolved in either prompt.
findings.fix: In 3.3a Build add an item: 'In `src/lib/security/csp.ts` (2.1a `buildCsp`) change `media-src` to `'self' blob: https:` for BOTH variants — linked recordings stream from arbitrary https hosts (PLAN §6 native_stream); update `csp.test.ts`; record the deviation from DESIGN §9 ("media-src Supabase host") in HANDOFF.' Change the Constraints sentence to 'do not touch `proxy.ts`; the only `next.config.ts`/`csp.ts` change allowed is the `media-src` widening above'. Then drop the `media-src` widening from 3.4 Build 8 (or make it 'already done in 3.3a').

findings.quote: if a valid cookie exists → `loadUnlockedShare`; else → `resolveShare(token, { password: null, headers: await headers() })`
findings.problem: For a link without a password the RPC returns `ok` on every GET and (per DESIGN §4.4 / 1.3b) increments `view_count` and re-checks `max_views` each time; the page is a Server Component and never sets the unlock cookie in that path, so every reload burns a view and `max_views` counts page loads. The prompt's manual script only covers the password case.
findings.fix: Add to Build 5: 'Passwordless links: every page load is an unlock (counts a view); say so in the ShareLinksPanel copy ("Views count each time the page is opened") and in HANDOFF; do not try to set the cookie from the page (Server Components cannot).' Add a manual-check bullet for a passwordless link (`view_count` increments per load).
